prompt:
Fish numbers in many coastal waters have fallen sharply. Some people believe that large areas of the sea should be closed to fishing so that stocks can recover, even though this would affect those who earn a living from fishing.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: The task expects a clear position: agree / disagree / partly agree
The real issue is closing large sea areas to fishing — it is not enough to simply say the seas should be protected in general
Supporting reasons: giving stocks time to recover, a more plentiful and more secure livelihood in the long run, and protecting marine life as a whole

A concession to the opposing view is expected: closure puts households that depend on fishing under short-term pressure, enforcement is costly, and it may push fishing pressure onto neighbouring areas
The stance must be clearly restated at the end; if partly agreeing, the condition (size of the area, duration, transitional support) should be stated
common_mistakes: Writing only about sea pollution without stating a stance
Not discussing the closure proposal and drifting into a general essay about environmental protection
Never addressing the situation of those who depend on fishing for a living
